crossRefs.note: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood?
Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,
won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
Yahweh says, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked…
“ ‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against…

translations.web: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit
translations.bsb: If I have walked in falsehood or my foot has rushed to deceit,
translations.kjv: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
translations.asv: If I have walked with falsehood, And my foot hath hasted to deceit;
